introduction.overview:
Syllogisms is a critical topic for the CMAT examination. This chapter covers the complete syllabus content as specified by the conducting body, with focus on the types of questions that appear in the entrance test.

The CMAT is one of the most competitive entrance examinations in Nepal, and thorough preparation of Syllogisms is essential for achieving a high rank. Past papers analysis shows that this topic consistently carries significant marks.

Students should combine systematic study with timed practice tests. Focus on accuracy first, then work on speed. Understanding concepts deeply is more effective than memorizing formulas, as the examination tests analytical ability.

A structured preparation plan covering this chapter, combined with regular revision and mock tests, will maximize your chances of success in the CMAT.
introduction.whyItMatters: High-frequency topic in CMAT. Thorough preparation of Syllogisms can significantly improve your entrance rank. Multiple questions appear from this chapter every year.
